fusions.name: Fixed Stare
fusions.desc: Strikes a target up to 7 tiles away for 13 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Marked] for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Thousand Glances
fusions.desc: Looses 5 bolts of arcane sight at once, spread apart, each dealing 7 damage that ignores resistances, with a 50% chance per hit to leave the target [Stalled] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Total Focus
fusions.desc: Your critical hit chance rises by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Nothing Escapes
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, your next strike gains 15% critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds.
